Its disk meets each routed strip once for each signed traversal of h. Its framing is the product disk framing. This convention follows by transporting the meridian along the product cancellation tube; it fixes the actual exterior marking. More precisely separate the strips by distinct normal coordinates, cut both just inside their common germs, and join the four short ends by the two planar rectangles in the endpoint balls.
